needWater: Water when the soil dries out
plantNeedsCaption: And a pot with a drainage hole — without it, pooled water rots the roots.
mistakeOverwatering: Watering every day "just to be safe" — that drowns the roots faster than it seems.
mistakePests: Ignoring early signs of pests: the sooner you notice, the easier it is to fix.
mistakeFertilizingSickPlant: Fertilizing a sick plant thinking it will "give it strength" — it usually makes things worse.
curiosityPhotosynthesis: During the day, plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen — they breathe almost the opposite of us.
curiosityPhototropism: Phototropism is the name for the phenomenon that makes the stem and leaves turn toward the light.
curiosityNightLeaves: Some species close their leaves at night and open them again in the morning, as if they were sleeping.
curiosityFungiNetworks: Underground, the roots of different plants can exchange nutrients through fungal networks.
benefitStressDescription: Caring for plants helps you relax and slow down.
benefitHumidityDescription: They help humidify and filter the environment.
benefitRoutineDescription: Watering, observing, noticing changes brings calm.
benefitGrowthDescription: Every new leaf is a result of your care.
faqDiagnoseQuestion: How does the AI diagnosis work?
faqDiagnoseAnswer: Tap "Diagnose my plant" here in Help (or go straight to the Photo tab and choose "Diagnose"), take a photo, and the AI analyzes what's in it: whether the plant is healthy, what might be wrong, and what to do next. It costs {{count}} credits per diagnosis, and it's saved to your history.
faqIdentifyAnswer: In the Photo tab, with "Identify" mode selected, take a close-up photo (or pick one from the gallery) of a leaf or flower. We send the image to Pl@ntNet, which recognizes the species and suggests a care profile for you to review before saving.
faqCareQuestion: Where do the light, temperature, and humidity values come from?
faqCareAnswer: After identification, we ask an AI about the species (watering, light, temperature, toxicity, and trivia) and fill in the fields automatically. You can adjust any value before saving — these numbers guide the plant's care.
faqSunAnswer: It's a more intuitive way to show the ideal amount of light, in 5 levels: from 1 sun (shade) to 5 suns (full sun). The more suns, the more direct light the plant needs.
faqWateringAnswer: When you register the plant, you set how many days apart it needs water. We automatically create the watering task, and it appears again under "For today" whenever the cycle repeats.
faqDeleteQuestion: How do I delete a plant?
faqDeleteAnswer: Open the plant and tap the trash icon at the top of the screen. This deletes the plant and all care tasks associated with it — this action cannot be undone.
faqSyncQuestion: Are my plants saved in the cloud?
faqSyncAnswer: Yes! Everything is saved to your account, so you can switch devices without losing your garden.
